ENTJ>INTJ.title: You finish big goals with quiet, steady focus.
ENTJ>INTJ.body: Seeing far ahead, deciding with clear logic, and moving forward with a plan sit at your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have the drive to move a room full of people and the focus to think things through deeply on your own. You set the direction with confidence in the meeting, then go home and polish the plan one more time. Your strength is that you can lead out front and refine in quiet, and switch between the two.
ENTJ>INTJ.say: "Let's go with this direction. …I'll sleep on the details and send them tomorrow."
ENTJ>INTJ.do: After pulling the whole group dinner together, you hold a one-person review session on the train home.
ENTJ>INTJ.worry: The more you're asked to lead, the less time you get to think alone. You're glad to be relied on, but you also want quiet time, and balancing the two takes energy every time.
ENTJ>INTJ.karai: You say "Leave it to me," then quietly carry it all yourself until midnight.

ENTJ>INTP.title: You have both the power to decide and the power to question.
ENTJ>INTP.body: Trusting your flashes of insight and thinking things through logically: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. Beyond that, you can gather people and drive toward a goal, and also take a system apart slowly on your own. You can stick to a plan, and you're flexible enough to rethink it midway. You reach conclusions fast, yet you can still stop and ask, "But is that really true?" You move freely between speed and depth.
ENTJ>INTP.say: "Okay, it's decided. …Wait, actually, it'd be more fun to rethink the whole premise."
ENTJ>INTP.do: You're the toughest critic of your own plan, picking it apart and rebuilding it.
ENTJ>INTP.worry: You want to decide quickly, but the more you think, the more answers you see, and you stall. You want time leading people and time thinking alone, so when your schedule gets too packed, you run out of breath.
ENTJ>INTP.karai: The conclusion was ready ages ago, but testing it got so fun that you're late handing it in.

ENTJ>ENTJ.title: You've built your own road to your goals, without hesitation.
ENTJ>ENTJ.body: Your temperament, the nature you were born with, and your character, the nature that grew through experience, are the same type. Working with people, seeing ahead, thinking things through, and following through on what you decide: these strengths have grown steadily, without wavering. Once you can see the goal, the steps fall into place on their own, and before you know it you're the one organizing everything. Because you know so clearly how you work best, places with no goal, or where nothing ever gets decided, can wear you out in ways you can't quite explain.
ENTJ>ENTJ.say: "So where's the goal? Let's work backward from there."
ENTJ>ENTJ.do: You set goals even for your days off, and keep an eye on your completion rate.
ENTJ>ENTJ.worry: When you move at your own pace, you only notice later that others couldn't keep up. You look for meaning even in rest, so it's hard to truly let go.
ENTJ>ENTJ.karai: You say "Let's take it easy," while drawing up a plan for taking it easy.

ENTJ>ENTP.title: You can set the path, and rebuild it along the way.
ENTJ>ENTP.body: Getting energy from people and thinking with both insight and logic: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. Added to that, you can plan ahead and follow through neatly, and also go with the flow in the moment. You're good at making plans, and just as good at enjoying it when things don't go to plan. Your strength is that you never move the goal, but you'll redesign the route as many times as it takes.
ENTJ>ENTP.say: "The deadline is Friday. No exceptions. …So, can I change the whole approach?"
ENTJ>ENTP.do: You write a tidy meeting agenda, then launch a whole new project out of the small talk on the day.
ENTJ>ENTP.worry: You want to stick to what you decided, and you want to try a more interesting road, both at the same time. You worry that changing course so often is wearing people out.
ENTJ>ENTP.karai: You prepared three backup plans, then went with a fourth that wasn't any of them.

ENTJ>INFJ.title: You see far ahead, and make a path for people's hearts too.
ENTJ>INFJ.body: Picturing future possibilities and moving forward with a clear plan: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. Layered on top, you can lead a group and think deeply alone, decide by logic and read how people feel. You don't just talk about ideals; you map out the steps to get there, and you notice anyone who might be left behind. You guide people with a quiet kind of strength.
ENTJ>INFJ.say: "Let's make this our goal. …Is everyone okay? Nobody pushing too hard?"
ENTJ>INFJ.do: While a younger coworker talks to you about their future, you're quietly drafting their five-year plan in your head.
ENTJ>INFJ.worry: Even when you know the right direction, you can't say it if someone might get hurt. You wear yourself out thinking about others' feelings, and only recover once you're alone.
ENTJ>INFJ.karai: You fit everyone's happiness into the plan. The only thing missing is breathing room for you.

ENTJ>INFP.title: You have the heart to dream big and the power to make it happen.
ENTJ>INFP.body: Your heart is drawn to possibilities no one can see yet: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you can rally people and get results, and also nurse your own feelings in quiet. You have the drive to decide and push ahead, and the softness to take an honest detour when your heart asks for one. You don't leave dreams as dreams; you shape them in a way you truly believe in. Your passion and your kindness come from the same place.
ENTJ>INFP.say: "We have to do this project. …But I want it in a form I truly believe in."
ENTJ>INFP.do: After pulling people in with your passion, you fight hard to protect some alone time to settle your feelings.
ENTJ>INFP.worry: Wanting results and wanting it to feel right in your heart don't easily point the same way. After leading a group, you need more time alone than you expected.
ENTJ>INFP.karai: You have a plan to change the world, but today's laundry is still waiting for the right mood.

ENTJ>ENFJ.title: You lead with strength, and with warmth on top.
ENTJ>ENFJ.body: Getting energy from people and moving ahead with foresight and a plan: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. Alongside that, you can judge things with clear logic and also care about each person's feelings. You state the team's goal clearly, and you still notice when someone's mood shifts. You're the kind of leader who won't give up on results or on people.
ENTJ>ENFJ.say: "Let's hit this target this month! …So, has anyone been feeling down lately?"
ENTJ>ENFJ.do: You run the meeting tightly, then check in privately with the person who barely spoke.
ENTJ>ENFJ.worry: When you should be firm, you picture how the other person feels and soften your words too much. Trying to move everyone forward, you end up being the one running around the most.
ENTJ>ENFJ.karai: You're so busy watching everyone else grow that your own goals keep getting pushed back.

ENTJ>ENFP.title: You can carry excitement all the way to the finish line.
ENTJ>ENFP.body: Being with people energizes you, and ideas and possibilities light you up: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. Layered on top, you decide with both logic and heart, and you can stick to a plan or follow your mood. You pull people in with a sudden idea, then wrap it up with real results at the end. With fun and follow-through, you brighten everyone around you.
ENTJ>ENFP.say: "This is going to be so much fun! …Okay, let's split up the roles and set a deadline."
ENTJ>ENFP.do: You start planning a surprise party on a whim, and before you know it you've made a schedule and a budget sheet.
ENTJ>ENFP.worry: You want to keep starting fun things, but you also want to finish everything you start, so life gets busy. When someone just needs you to listen, you bring up efficiency first and regret it later.
ENTJ>ENFP.karai: The one who said "Let's keep it chill" is running the whole thing most seriously.

ENTJ>ISTJ.title: You build big visions step by solid step.
ENTJ>ISTJ.body: Deciding with logic and moving ahead with foresight: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. Added to that, you can rally people and work quietly alone, see future possibilities and check facts one by one. Even while aiming high, you never neglect the numbers and steps right in front of you. You're a dependable doer with both drive and steadiness.
ENTJ>ISTJ.say: "We're aiming for number one in the country. …First, show me all of last month's data."
ENTJ>ISTJ.do: After talking about your dream, you open a spreadsheet and work out exactly what it'll cost.
ENTJ>ISTJ.worry: Wanting to try something new and wanting the safe method pull against each other, so decisions take time. After leading for a while, you start missing quiet time to just work.
ENTJ>ISTJ.karai: Even for an adventure, you won't leave until the manual is finished.

ENTJ>ISFJ.title: You see the big picture, and take good care of the people close to you.
ENTJ>ISFJ.body: Planning ahead and seeing things through: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. Beyond that, you can stand in front and support from behind, look far ahead and value the facts in front of you, decide by logic and stay close to people's feelings. You read the big flow while noticing the small troubles of the people near you. Strength and kindness live side by side in you, naturally.
ENTJ>ISFJ.say: "Let's get this far by next year. …Oh, but first, are you feeling okay?"
ENTJ>ISFJ.do: While drawing up the team's yearly plan, you add everyone's birthday to the calendar.
ENTJ>ISFJ.worry: Even when you want to lead, your care for others comes first and you step back. The harder you try to do your part well, the more your own rest gets pushed aside.
ENTJ>ISFJ.karai: You can see the company's future clearly, but not how many vacation days you have left.

ENTJ>ESTJ.title: You move a team with a vision of the future and a feel for the real work.
ENTJ>ESTJ.body: Getting energy from people, deciding with logic, and moving ahead with a plan: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. Alongside that, you can picture possibilities no one has seen yet and lean on past experience and facts. You set new goals and also check, with a hands-on eye, whether they'll actually work. Your way of doing things is neither a fantasy nor just following old habits.
ENTJ>ESTJ.say: "Here's where I want us in three years. …So, let's decide what to say at tomorrow's morning meeting."
ENTJ>ESTJ.do: When you pitch a new project, you bring three past examples that worked.
ENTJ>ESTJ.worry: You want to change things, and you want to protect what's already working, so drawing the line is hard. You use your own tidy standards as the benchmark and expect others to move at your speed.
ENTJ>ESTJ.karai: You say "Do it your own way," but you've already decided the format for handing it in.

ENTJ>ESFJ.title: You can plan a place where everyone belongs.
ENTJ>ESFJ.body: Getting energy from people and moving ahead neatly with a plan: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. Layered on top, you can picture what's ahead and value what's real right now, decide by logic and care for how people feel. You set big goals and still create a mood where everyone can work happily. You're a reliable caretaker who protects both results and good vibes.
ENTJ>ESFJ.say: "Let's ride this momentum all the way! …Oh, and there's tea and snacks ready for everyone."
ENTJ>ESFJ.do: You plan the event down to the minute, and on the day you go around thanking every single person.
ENTJ>ESFJ.worry: When you need results, the wish not to upset anyone shows up. You love being relied on, take on too much, and suddenly your calendar is packed.
ENTJ>ESFJ.karai: You planned everyone's seats, and forgot to save one for yourself.

ENTJ>ISTP.title: You knock out big goals lightly, with skill and clever fixes.
ENTJ>ISTP.body: Thinking things through and deciding with logic: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. Beyond that, you can lead people and work quietly with your hands, see far ahead and grab the facts in front of you, stick to a plan and adjust lightly to the situation. Once the goal is set, you skip the fussy steps, pick "the best move I can make right now," and get results fast.
ENTJ>ISTP.say: "The goal is set. …How? I'll mess around with it first and figure it out."
ENTJ>ISTP.do: After announcing the team's goal, you quietly start building a prototype by yourself.
ENTJ>ISTP.worry: Wanting to plan ahead and wanting to act on the spot take turns, so even you find your pace hard to read. When you're put in charge of a group, you miss working alone with your hands.
ENTJ>ISTP.karai: It's written all over your face: fixing it yourself would be faster than this long meeting.

ENTJ>ISFP.title: You're gentle and sensitive, with the strength to move straight ahead.
ENTJ>ISFP.body: You're a calm, sensitive person who values your own pace and feelings. You also have the strength to set a goal, lead people, and push things forward. So when something matters and you can't let it go, you act with surprising clarity. You have both softness and a strong backbone.
ENTJ>ISFP.say: "Either is fine with me. …Oh, but this one thing, I'd like to do my way."
ENTJ>ISFP.do: Usually you're the listener, but when it counts, you suddenly lay out the plan and get everyone moving.
ENTJ>ISFP.worry: You want things to stay peaceful, but when things drag on, you get quietly irritated. You hold back what you want to say for too long, then sometimes say it too strongly all at once.
ENTJ>ISFP.karai: Inside your "Anything's fine," there are three conditions you won't budge on.

ENTJ>ESTP.title: You map out the winning move, then nail it on the spot.
ENTJ>ESTP.body: Getting energy from people and deciding quickly with logic: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. Added to that, you can plan far ahead and also seize the chance right in front of you. You build a long-range strategy, yet when the moment comes, your body moves before your head does. You're a person of action who shines brightest when it really counts.
ENTJ>ESTP.say: "Here's the strategy. …Eh, we'll improvise the rest once we're there!"
ENTJ>ESTP.do: You set a rough route for the trip, then keep changing the details on the day depending on the crowds.
ENTJ>ESTP.worry: You want to read ahead and move, but you jump at whatever's fun right now and the plan gets pushed back. Putting speed first, you skip the small checks and regret it later.
ENTJ>ESTP.karai: Three days after making a long-term plan, you're already off on a whole new gamble.

ENTJ>ESFP.title: You liven up the room, and still get everyone to the goal.
ENTJ>ESFP.body: The more you're with people, the more energy you get: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you can plan ahead and enjoy the moment, decide by logic and sense how people feel. You build a team that's always laughing, and you still deliver real results. Fun and follow-through are both strengths that brighten everyone around you.
ENTJ>ESFP.say: "Let's have a blast today! …Oh, and we meet at 8 tomorrow. Don't be late."
ENTJ>ESFP.do: You keep the after-party lively while quietly starting to talk about the next goal.
ENTJ>ESFP.worry: You want to enjoy the moment, but part of your mind is always on the next step. Because you care about everyone's feelings, a hard thing you had to say tends to stay with you.
ENTJ>ESFP.karai: You make plans on a whim, then carry them out more precisely than anyone, and everyone's shocked.

ENTP>INTJ.title: You turn flashes of inspiration into a solid blueprint.
ENTP>INTJ.body: Possibilities excite you, and you think things through logically: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. Layered on top, you can grow ideas by talking with people and refine them deeply alone, act on a whim and plan far ahead. Your ideas don't just overflow; you can build them into a long plan and see it through. You have both a wide range of ideas and the reliability to finish them.
ENTP>INTJ.say: "Wouldn't it be fun to think about it backward? …Okay, I'll sort out the steps through next month."
ENTP>INTJ.do: You take an idea from casual chat, go home, and turn it into a full proposal overnight.
ENTP>INTJ.worry: You want to grow ideas by talking, but if you talk too much you get tired and want to be alone. Torn between trying things right away and planning properly first, you're often slow to start.
ENTP>INTJ.karai: The plan in your head is perfect, but you go ahead without explaining it to anyone and surprise them all.

ENTP>INTP.title: You toss ideas around with people, then deepen them alone.
ENTP>INTP.body: Trusting your insights, thinking with logic, and moving flexibly with the situation: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, talking with people energizes you, and so does thinking things through alone. In a discussion you keep widening the topic, and on the way home you quietly take the idea apart. Your strength is moving back and forth between widening and digging deep.
ENTP>INTP.say: "Tell me more about that! …Actually, let me think about it on my own for a bit."
ENTP>INTP.do: On the way home from a lively dinner, you jot down notes alone, continuing the day's debate.
ENTP>INTP.worry: There's a big gap between days you want to talk and days you don't want to see anyone, so planning your schedule is tricky. Thinking is so much fun that you sometimes feel satisfied before you've actually done anything.
ENTP>INTP.karai: On days with no one to debate, you argue with online articles in your head.

ENTP>ENTJ.title: You take a sudden idea all the way to results.
ENTP>ENTJ.body: Getting energy from people and thinking with insight and logic: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. Beyond that, you can move flexibly with the flow and also plan ahead and follow through. You toss out a fun idea in a meeting, and before long you've already assigned owners and deadlines. Coming up with ideas and pulling them together, you can do both on your own, and people count on that.
ENTP>ENTJ.say: "How about something like this? …Okay, decided. Prototype by next week."
ENTP>ENTJ.do: You turn an idea from small talk into a project that same day and start gathering people.
ENTP>ENTJ.worry: Wanting to try new ideas and wanting to keep the plan clash, and sometimes you get tied up by your own rules. Because you move with so much momentum, you're slow to notice people who can't keep up.
ENTP>ENTJ.karai: For something you "just kind of tried," the report is suspiciously impressive.

ENTP>ENTP.title: You got here by always chasing what's interesting.
ENTP>ENTP.body: Your temperament, the nature you were born with, and your character, the nature that grew through experience, are the same type. Growing ideas by talking with people and flipping the obvious upside down: these strengths have grown steadily, without wavering. When you meet something new or a question with no right answer, your eyes light up. Because your style is so clear, places full of fixed routine tasks can drain your energy before you even know why.
ENTP>ENTP.say: "Okay, but what if we just stopped doing all of it?"
ENTP>ENTP.do: Every new hobby comes with a full set of gear, and three months later you're talking about the next one.
ENTP>ENTP.worry: You're great at starting, but you tend to blame yourself for getting bored of keeping it going. When a dull place drains you, it's usually not your fault. It's just not the right place for you.
ENTP>ENTP.karai: Once the debate heats up, you forget you started out on the other side.

ENTP>INFJ.title: With your insight, you gently light up other people's futures.
ENTP>INFJ.body: Picturing possibilities no one can see yet: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. Layered on top, you can grow ideas through conversation and reflect deeply alone, think with logic and read feelings, move lightly and plan ahead. You can offer a sharp idea in a way that reaches the other person's heart. With your mind and your kindness, you give people a push forward.
ENTP>INFJ.say: "You could also look at it this way. …Which one matters most to you?"
ENTP>INFJ.do: While listening to a friend's worries, you put into words what they really feel, before they've even noticed it themselves.
ENTP>INFJ.worry: Even when you think of something interesting, you hold back, wondering if it might hurt someone. Because you take others' feelings in so deeply, you need lots of alone time to recover.
ENTP>INFJ.karai: You give brilliant life advice to others, but for yourself it's just "Eh, it'll work out."

ENTP>INFP.title: You add a kind heart to your free-flowing ideas.
ENTP>INFP.body: Valuing your insights and moving flexibly with the situation: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. Added to that, you can get lively with people and let your imagination grow alone, sharpen things with logic and treasure feelings. You don't just come up with fun ideas; you fill them with the wish to help someone. Humor and warmth blend in you naturally.
ENTP>INFP.say: "That's so funny! …But the person it's about might feel a little sad."
ENTP>INFP.do: After getting lost in a debate with everyone, you go home and write something like a story, all alone.
ENTP>INFP.worry: Even when your head agrees, you can't move if your heart isn't on board. After a lively time with people, you look back alone and wonder if your words hurt anyone.
ENTP>INFP.karai: The margins of your notebook hold equal parts brilliant ideas, doodles, and feelings you never said out loud.

ENTP>ENFJ.title: With fun ideas, you bring everyone's hearts together.
ENTP>ENFJ.body: Getting energy from people and being moved by possibilities: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. Layered on top, you can think with logic and care about feelings, move lightly in the moment and plan ahead. You fire up the room with ideas and still lay out a path everyone can get on board with. With your ideas and your gift for bringing people together, you help others feel hopeful.
ENTP>ENFJ.say: "Wouldn't this be fun? …I'll set it up so everyone actually wants to do it."
ENTP>ENFJ.do: You pitch a new project with a smile, and quietly talk one-on-one beforehand with anyone who might object.
ENTP>ENFJ.worry: Even when you want to make a sharp point, you sometimes swallow it, thinking about the mood and the other person's feelings. The more you take on the role of bringing everyone together, the less time you have to freely try out your ideas.
ENTP>ENFJ.karai: After taking in everyone's opinions, your original idea is nowhere to be found.

ENTP>ENFP.title: You spread the fun with both logic and heart.
ENTP>ENFP.body: Getting energy from people and moving lightly on your insights: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you can test ideas with logic and stay close to people's feelings. You have a sharp mind that enjoys a debate and a wish to make people smile, so people naturally gather when you talk. You're lively, quick-witted, and well loved.
ENTP>ENFP.say: "Isn't that logic a little off? …I mean, I totally get how you feel, though."
ENTP>ENFP.do: A new game pops into your head mid-chat, and you rework the rules so everyone can enjoy it.
ENTP>ENFP.worry: You want to say clearly what you think is right, but picturing someone's disappointed face puts on the brakes. Your interests keep shifting and you also value your friendships, so there's never enough time.
ENTP>ENFP.karai: Five minutes after saying "Let's think about this calmly," you're the most fired-up person in the room.

ENTP>ISTJ.title: You turn bold ideas into reality, step by solid step.
ENTP>ISTJ.body: Thinking things through and judging with logic: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. Beyond that, you can grow ideas by talking and work steadily alone, look at possibilities and check the facts, move flexibly in the moment and follow a plan reliably. Your strength is that you don't let ideas end as talk; you break them into steps and make them real.
ENTP>ISTJ.say: "Wouldn't it be fun to do it this way? …First, let's check the past records."
ENTP>ISTJ.do: Even when you think of a new way to do something, you test it small first and put the results in a table.
ENTP>ISTJ.worry: You want to try new things and you want to keep the reliable way, so it's hard to choose. When you're the rule-keeper for too long, you miss having chances to share ideas.
ENTP>ISTJ.karai: You test your wildest ideas with the most boring steps of anyone.

ENTP>ISFJ.title: You're quietly supportive, with ideas that break the usual mold.
ENTP>ISFJ.body: You're a kind supporter who looks out for others and carefully handles what's been decided. You also have a curiosity that questions the obvious and wants to find new ways. So while doing things "the usual way," you're quietly thinking up a better one. You bring both a sense of calm and a spark of inspiration.
ENTP>ISFJ.say: "The usual way is fine. …Though I was thinking this might make it a little easier."
ENTP>ISFJ.do: You finish the task you were asked to do perfectly, and you've also built a system so anyone can do it easily next time.
ENTP>ISFJ.worry: You're good at going along with others, but when the same thing repeats too long, part of you gets bored. Even with a good idea, you sometimes can't bring it up because of the mood in the room.
ENTP>ISFJ.karai: While saying "Oh, I'm nobody," you're holding the boldest improvement plan in the room.

ENTP>ESTJ.title: You can make new ideas run smoothly in the real world.
ENTP>ESTJ.body: Getting energy from people and deciding with logic: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. Added to that, you can chase new ideas and rely on experience and facts, move flexibly and move with a plan. One moment you pitch an out-there idea, the next you've nailed down the steps and who does what. You're a hands-on leader with both ideas and the power to make them happen.
ENTP>ESTJ.say: "Why don't we just shake this up? …Okay, let's decide who's on it and the deadline right now."
ENTP>ESTJ.do: You switch the usual meeting to "Let's do it standing up today," and still end it right on time.
ENTP>ESTJ.worry: Because you know why rules matter, it's hard to balance that with wanting to try new things. When you're the one in charge, you put being right first and can come across as harsh.
ENTP>ESTJ.karai: You say "Let's break the mold," then write a step-by-step guide for breaking it.

ENTP>ESFJ.title: With lively ideas, you make everyone's days more fun.
ENTP>ESFJ.body: The more you're with people, the more energy you get: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. Beyond that, you can dream up new possibilities and treasure everyday life, think with logic and care about feelings, move lightly in the moment and faithfully keep what you've decided. You can shape a fun idea into something everyone will love. You're at the center of the circle, warming up the room.
ENTP>ESFJ.say: "Wouldn't this be fun? …Don't worry, I'll work around everyone's schedules."
ENTP>ESFJ.do: You bring a small new twist to every get-together, and you also keep perfect track of who's coming and who's paid.
ENTP>ESFJ.worry: Even when a cheeky comeback pops into your head, you swallow it for the other person's sake. You love doing things for others, so it's hard to find time to try your own ideas.
ENTP>ESFJ.karai: The one who pitched the silliest idea is also the one cleaning up most carefully.

ENTP>ISTP.title: With logic and a light touch, you get through any problem.
ENTP>ISTP.body: Thinking things through and moving flexibly with the situation: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. Layered on top, you can grow ideas by talking and work quietly alone, see future possibilities and grab the facts in front of you. You don't just talk about ideas; you get your hands on them and test them right away. When people are stuck, they count on you for both your words and your hands.
ENTP>ISTP.say: "In theory, it should work. …Well, let's just try it."
ENTP>ISTP.do: When you buy a new appliance, you try every button before reading the manual.
ENTP>ISTP.worry: Your mood swings between wanting to debate and wanting to work without talking to anyone, so people may think you're moody. You go back and forth between wanting to expand ideas and wanting to deal only with what's solid in front of you.
ENTP>ISTP.karai: You said "I'll explain later," and it's already fixed.

ENTP>ISFP.title: With a free spirit, you enjoy both your ideas and your senses.
ENTP>ISFP.body: Moving flexibly with the situation and wanting to stay free: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. Added to that, you can get lively with people and enjoy quiet time alone, imagine possibilities and savor what's in front of you, think with logic and treasure feelings. You enjoy things with your mind, and savor them with your heart and body. Both are your own way of having fun.
ENTP>ISFP.say: "Wouldn't it be fun to do it like this? …But right now, I just want to look at this view."
ENTP>ISFP.do: An idea from chatting with friends turns into a little handmade piece you make alone at home.
ENTP>ISFP.worry: Even when you want to say something sharp, thinking of the other person's feelings makes you hesitate. You love getting lively with people, but without time alone, you tire quickly.
ENTP>ISFP.karai: Your motto is "keep the calendar open," yet you've already bookmarked every exhibit you're curious about.

ENTP>ESTP.title: With ideas and action, you never miss a chance.
ENTP>ESTP.body: Getting energy from people, thinking with logic, and going with the flow: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you can dream up possibilities that don't exist yet and quickly grasp what's real in front of you. When you get a fun idea, you've already found where and how to test it. Fast at thinking and fast at moving, you're a dependable doer.
ENTP>ESTP.say: "This could be a new business! …Okay, let's go see the place right now."
ENTP>ESTP.do: You come up with an idea on a trip and try it out on the locals right there.
ENTP>ESTP.worry: You want to chase both future possibilities and present fun, so your schedule is always packed. Since you think while moving, you move on before looking back, and tend to repeat the same mistakes.
ENTP>ESTP.karai: By the time you say "Let's be careful," you've already taken the first step.

ENTP>ESFP.title: With brilliant ideas, you make the whole moment fun.
ENTP>ESFP.body: Getting energy from people and moving lightly with the flow: that's your core, in both your temperament and your character. Layered on top, you can dream up new possibilities and savor the fun right in front of you, think with logic and sense people's feelings. You spin fun games out of casual chat one after another, and get everyone around you smiling. Wherever you are, the place lights up.
ENTP>ESFP.say: "Hey, I just had a great idea! …If everyone's in, let's do it right now."
ENTP>ESFP.do: When rain cancels the plans, you turn it on the spot into a game night at home and get everyone excited.
ENTP>ESFP.worry: You want to protect the fun, but when you spot a contradiction, you can't help pointing it out. Because you're sensitive to people's feelings, you remember the moment the room went cold for a long time.
ENTP>ESFP.karai: The one who said "Just for fun" is having the most serious fun of all.
